title: Structure properties of Banach spaces of I-null sequences
summary: We investigate structural properties of the ideal-null sequence spaces c_{0,I} and c_{0,I}(X), and of the quotient l_infty/c_{0,I}, emphasizing the interaction between Banach space theory and combinatorial, topological, and measure-theoretic properties of the underlying ideal. We study classical problems related to c_0, including the dual space, compactness criteria, bounded and compact c_{0,I}-valued operators, Sobczyk-type extension phenomena, and complemented copies of c_0.
